what: A fitted camera for the desk plane of public/plates/original/desk-plate.png, measured on the 1536 x 864 plate. A STARTING POINT for Patch 03 (the match lab), not its result. Every number is a design assumption about an unknown real scene except where marked 'measured'. It replaces the seed made for the superseded 736 x 672 photo.
units: cm in the world, photo pixels in the image. The desk top is the plane Y = 0. X is measured from the camera centre line (positive right). Zd is measured from the FRONT edge of the desk top towards the wall.
model: pinhole camera looking horizontally, principal point (cx, horizonY). Equivalent to a camera pitched DOWN by pitchDegEquivalent with the principal point at the image centre.

equivalentToThePatch03Sliders.note: With the principal point at the image centre (y = 432), the horizon sits at y = 395.6 only if the camera looks DOWN by about 1.1 degrees: atan((432 - 395.6) / 1895). The plate's vertical lines stay vertical, so a pure lens shift (principal point at x = 544.7, 223 px left of the plate centre) reproduces it better than a yaw. HORIZON IS UNCERTAIN: the desk edges give y = 396, but the room's ceiling and baseboard lines point to about y = 464. The seed follows the desk edges because the books sit on the desk. Patch 03's lab should let the horizon slide between 380 and 470 and the person chooses by eye.

measuredOnThePlate.horizonYFromTheDepthLines: about 396 from the desk's side edges; about 464 from the room's ceiling and baseboard lines (see the note above)
measuredOnThePlate.frontApronFaceY: 565.7 down to about 580 (the vertical face under the desk top; NOT desk top)

scaleAssumption.why: Kept at 233 cm so the desk is the same size as in the first plan (3 monitors at about 47 cm each). The desk is 1.38 x larger on this plate, so px per cm rises from 2.7 to 3.73. A design assumption: the plate has no known real size.

pile.why: on the desk between the lamp (x 283-340) and the keyboard mat (x 520+), clear of the chair; the free zone is about 52 cm wide

riser.why: front edge of the right end, beside the speaker and webcam; the free zone is about 52 cm wide. Keep the riser on the desk and off the new bookshelf at the right
